chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, who said:
Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: “Do not recite in the obligatory prayer less than one surah, nor more than that.”

key_terms.سُورَةٍ: a complete surah of the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: How much of the Qur'an should be recited in an obligatory prayer according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding recitation in the obligatory prayer. It indicates that in the faridah, one should recite a complete surah, neither less than a surah nor more than one surah.
